Vs.
Mong Taja Mongpru Salin & Another
full_judgment: 2. It transpires from the petition that the complainant opposite party No. 1 filed an application before the Commissioner, Chittagong Division on 28.3.77 alleging inter-alia, that his forefathers established the only famous Buddhist Monastary more than 300 years ago in the Pahartali village and dedicated vast landed property for maintenance thereof., that his residence being far away from the said Monastary he has authorised Bijayananda Bhikku to look after and maintain the said Monastary and the property thereof as priest of the said Monastary and that some bad people out of greed cut away many valuable trees there from worth about taka eight or ten thousand. The said application was sent to the Deputy Commissioner, Chittagong for taking necessary action and ultimately the Officer-in-charge, Raozan P.S. treating the same as an F.I.R. started Raozan P.S. Case No. 3(5)77 under section 379 of the Penal Code. Investigation having been completed, Police submitted final report on 25.7.77 stating, inter alia, that the allegation as to cutting of the trees by the petitioner and other was true, that the land in question covered by R.S. Plot No. 5552 under Khatian No. 1438 belonged to the Buddhist Monastary and was in possession of Mohamuni Buddhadev Thakur, Shebayet Lal-mohan Mahastabir and after him Shebayet Jinabangsha Mahathero, that there was a Committee constituted by local Buddhist people consisting of the petitioner and others for proper management and care of the Monastary, that in course of time part of the Monastary became dilapidated and for repairing thereof some bricks were manufactured locally and for that matter the petitioner and others raised subscriptions and cut some trees for burning the said bricks due to which the case had been started.
